title: Lending-company collector shot dead and his motorcycle taken in Boganga II, Marawi City
summary: A collector of Panjobjoban Lending Corporation was shot dead by unidentified armed men in the Boganga Shelter area of Barangay Boganga II, Marawi City, at about 4 p.m. on Saturday, 21 November 2026. The attackers fled with his motorcycle. The Marawi City Police Station launched a hot pursuit; the motive and the suspects' identities were not yet known.

sources.title: Lending Company Collector Killed in Marawi Shooting; Motorcycle Reportedly Taken by Suspects

title: Motorcycle driver shot dead and his passenger wounded at a gas station in Manaulanan, Tugunan
summary: Unidentified gunmen fired on a motorcycle driver and his female passenger at a gasoline station in Sitio SPDA, Barangay Manaulanan, Tugunan, Special Geographic Area, at about 6:55 a.m. on Sunday, 22 November 2026, as they rode from Barangay Silik toward Pikit. The driver, not yet identified, died at the scene; the passenger, Naribae Mangansakan Cansi, was wounded and taken to a hospital. The motive and the gunmen were not yet known.

sources.title: Driver Killed, Female Passenger Wounded in Gas Station Shooting in BARMM’s SGA
